blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals ANTIPOLO—Coach LA Tenorio summed up his frustrations over Magnolia’s Game 2 loss to TNT in the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Wednesday during a huddle that was heard on livestream. Tenorio shouted unprintables at his players after the Hotshots once again fell behind by double digits against a Tropang 5G side that would eventually end up getting a 2-0 lead in the best-of-five series with a 91-73 win at Ynares Center here.
